name: Path
comment:
Path class provides static functions to combine polygons with boolean operations:
unite, intersect, exclude, subtract the shapes in front or behind, divide into faces, or crop by the top shape.
Shapes are listed in stacking order, the first at the back and the last in front, like the order you would draw them in.
A shape is a polygon (a Group, or any iterable of points), or a list of rings that together form a polygon with holes,
such as the result of another Path function. Every result is such a list of rings: an outer ring followed by its
holes, in opposite orientations, which [`CanvasForm.compound`](#link) draws as one path. Rings are open (the first point
is not repeated), 2D, and never share Pts with the input. Clockwise and counterclockwise rings are the same shape, and
a self-intersecting ring covers what `form.polygon` would fill (the nonzero rule). Input vertices closer together than a
millionth of the largest absolute coordinate are merged before finding intersections. For small shapes at large offsets,
work in local coordinates to avoid losing detail to this tolerance or the Float32 output.
See [Op guide](../guide/Op-0400.html) for details.

signatures.comment:
Crop: use the frontmost (last) shape as a mask, keeping the faces of the other shapes inside it and deleting the mask itself.
Like [`Path.divide`](#link), the shapes under the mask stay divided where they overlap.
See a [demo here](https://ptsjs.org/demo/?name=path.crop).
signatures.returns_comment: an array of polygons, one per face inside the mask, each an outer ring followed by its holes

parameters.name: shapes
parameters.comment: an Array/Iterable of polygons in stacking order, back to front. Each is a Group or an Iterable<PtLike>, or a list of rings for a polygon with holes.

signatures.comment:
Divide: split the shapes at every crossing into separate faces. Each face is the largest area not cut by any edge, so
a region inside two shapes is its own face, and a self-overlapping region of one shape is too.
signatures.returns_comment: an array of polygons, one per face, each an outer ring followed by its holes

parameters.name: shapes
parameters.comment: an Array/Iterable of polygons in stacking order, back to front. Each is a Group or an Iterable<PtLike>, or a list of rings for a polygon with holes.

signatures.comment: Exclude: keep the area inside an odd number of shapes, so where two shapes overlap becomes a hole.
signatures.returns_comment: the rings of the result: each outer ring followed by its holes; empty if the shapes cancel out

parameters.name: shapes
parameters.comment: an Array/Iterable of polygons in stacking order, back to front. Each is a Group or an Iterable<PtLike>, or a list of rings for a polygon with holes.

signatures.comment: Intersect: keep only the area inside every shape.
signatures.returns_comment: the rings of the common polygon: each outer ring followed by its holes; empty if the shapes do not all overlap

parameters.name: shapes
parameters.comment: an Array/Iterable of polygons in stacking order, back to front. Each is a Group or an Iterable<PtLike>, or a list of rings for a polygon with holes.

signatures.comment: Minus Back: subtract every shape behind from the frontmost (last) shape.
signatures.returns_comment: the rings of what remains of the last shape: each outer ring followed by its holes; empty if nothing remains

parameters.name: shapes
parameters.comment: an Array/Iterable of polygons in stacking order, back to front. Each is a Group or an Iterable<PtLike>, or a list of rings for a polygon with holes.

tags.text: `Path.minusBack( [wall, window] )` keeps the part of `window` not covered by `wall`

signatures.comment: Minus Front: subtract every shape in front from the backmost (first) shape.
signatures.returns_comment: the rings of what remains of the first shape: each outer ring followed by its holes; empty if nothing remains

parameters.name: shapes
parameters.comment: an Array/Iterable of polygons in stacking order, back to front. Each is a Group or an Iterable<PtLike>, or a list of rings for a polygon with holes.

signatures.comment: Unite: merge all shapes into one polygon (the area inside any shape).
signatures.returns_comment: the rings of the merged polygon: each outer ring followed by its holes; empty if the shapes have no area
